ValidationRule.description: Validation rule to restrict users to move the status to Complete if Governance Criteria fields are blank.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, !ISNEW(), RecordType.DeveloperName = 'ANZ_Plus_Governance_Lending_Evaluation', ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Complete'), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Status__c , 'Evaluation Completed'), OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(Serviceability_Outcome__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Case_Notes_Outcome__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Collateral_Valuation_Outcome__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Conduct_Outcome__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Debts_Serviceability_Outcome__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Expenses_Serviceability_Outcome__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Hypercare_Focus_Area_Outcome__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Income_Serviceability_Outcome__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Purpose_of_Loan_Outcome__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Material_Change_Outcome__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please ensure all picklist fields in the Governance Criteria section are completed before changing the status to Complete.
